meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,省下输入字数并留一份可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话都因记忆文件太长而挤占上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink memory files to a compact format to cut input tokens, keeping a backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long memory files keep eating your context window.

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、待办、偏好这类自然语言文件压缩成穴居人语,减少输入 token。压缩版覆盖原文件,可读备份存到系统数据目录(不在源文件旁),避免被自动加载。
howto.when: 输入 /caveman-compress <文件路径>,或用户要求压缩记忆文件时接管。只处理 .md、.txt、.tex 等自然语言文件,代码类文件不改。

say.note: 压缩后覆盖原文,备份存到数据目录

say.text: 把 ~/todos.md 压缩一下,省点输入 token
把这份偏好文档压成穴居人语
say.note: 只压文字,代码块和路径原样保留

howto.what_en: Compresses natural-language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman speech to cut input tokens. The compressed version overwrites the original; a readable backup goes to an out-of-tree data dir, not beside the source.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-compress <filepath> or when the user asks to compress a memory file. Only natural-language files (.md, .txt, .tex, etc.) are handled; code files are left alone.

say_en.note: Overwrites it; backup goes to the data dir

say_en.text: Squash this preferences file into caveman speak
say_en.note: Only prose is compressed; code stays intact
